00:00-00:30 | Intro | A deep, resonant synth bassline and a crisp, four-on-the-floor kick drum establish a steady, club‑ready groove. Subtle hi‑hats and a faint atmospheric pad fill out the low‑mid spectrum, creating a spacious, immersive soundstage.
00:30-00:45 | Build‑up | Additional percussive elements—shuffling hi‑hats, a snappy clap, and a rising white‑noise sweep—gradually increase in intensity, while the bassline becomes more pronounced and the synth pad swells, heightening anticipation.
00:45-01:00 | Drop / Main Groove | The full drum pattern locks in, delivering a driving, dance‑floor‑focused rhythm. The bassline remains dominant, providing a powerful low‑end foundation, while the synth pad adds a subtle harmonic texture. The mix is clean and punchy, with the kick and bass tightly side‑chained for maximum impact.
01:00-01:15 | Breakdown | Percussion recedes, leaving the bassline and pad to create a more minimal, hypnotic atmosphere. A filtered version of the main synth motif is introduced, building tension for the next section.
01:15-01:30 | Build‑up 2 | Percussive elements re‑enter, layered with a rising filter sweep and a short, staccato synth stab. The energy climbs toward the next drop.
01:30-01:45 | Drop / Main Groove (reprise) | The full groove returns, now with added subtle melodic accents and a slightly more aggressive high‑frequency sheen, reinforcing the track’s driving momentum.
01:45-02:00 | Outro | Elements gradually strip away, leaving the bassline and a fading pad to close the piece, allowing the listener to exit the groove smoothly.
02:00-02:15 | Final Fade‑out | The bassline and pad dissolve into a low‑pass filtered ambience, ending the track on a subdued, lingering note.
02:15-02:30 | Extended Outro / Fade‑out | The track continues to fade, with the bassline and pad slowly disappearing into silence, providing a clean, professional conclusion.
02:30-02:45 | Fade‑out (final) | The last remnants of the bass and pad fade out completely, leaving a brief moment of silence.
02:45-03:00 | Silence | A short pause of complete silence follows the fade‑out, emphasizing the track’s polished production and giving the listener a moment to reflect.
03:00-03:15 | Fade‑out (final) | The silence is broken by a final, subtle re‑introduction of the bassline and pad, which then gently fade out once more.

sections.raw:
00:00-00:31 | Intro | Sparse electronic ambience with a subtle synth pad and a faint, filtered kick that hints at the forthcoming beat.
00:31-00:49 | Build‑up / Pre‑drop | A short, rhythmic vocal sample (“Baby, if you need me”) is introduced, layered over a rising synth arpeggio and a gradually intensifying drum pattern.
00:49-01:00 | Drop / Main Hook | The full beat drops in with a punchy, side‑chain‑compressed kick, crisp snare/clap, and a driving synth bass. The vocal hook “Baby, if you need me” repeats in a tight, rhythmic pattern, creating a catchy, club‑ready chorus.
01:00-01:12 | Verse 1 | The instrumentation pulls back slightly, allowing the lead vocal to deliver the first lyrical verse. The synth pads become more atmospheric, and the drums settle into a steadier groove.
01:12-01:24 | Pre‑Chorus / Build‑up | A short build‑up re‑introduces the rising synth arpeggio and a filtered white‑noise sweep, leading back into the main hook.
01:24-01:39 | Chorus / Main Hook (reprise) | The full drop returns, reinforcing the central vocal phrase and adding layered harmonies for extra impact.
01:39-01:52 | Verse 2 | Similar to the first verse, with slight variations in the synth texture and a more pronounced bass line.
01:52-02:04 | Pre‑Chorus / Build‑up | Re‑iteration of the build‑up elements, preparing for the final climax.
02:04-02:18 | Chorus / Main Hook (final) | The hook is delivered with maximum energy, additional vocal ad‑libs, and a slightly more aggressive synth lead.
02:18-02:30 | Outro / Fade‑out | The beat gradually strips back to the core synth pad and a filtered kick, while the vocal sample repeats and fades, leaving a lingering sense of the track’s hypnotic groove.
